name: Inspector Mildew Grey
note: Sent by the rival town of Brinemarsh with a forged writ and a real grudge, to sabotage the festival — but he arrived to find the cheese already gone and has spent the whole day trying to take credit for it anyway. Carries a clipboard he cannot actually read.

abilities.name: Forged Writ
abilities.desc: Advantage on Deception checks made while holding the clipboard. The seal is a bottlecap.
